test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

The team _____ children on proper safety procedures.
solution:
The correct answer is: **educated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense**, so the correct form of the verb should also be in the past tense.
 
• Among the given options, the past tense form of the verb is **'educated'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *The team educated children on proper safety procedures*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect because:
 
 
• **educate **- This is the base form of the verb. It is incorrect because it does not match the past tense context implied by the rest of the sentence.
 
• **education **- This is a noun, not a verb, and does not fit grammatically in the structure of the sentence which requires a verb.
 
• **educating **- This is the present participle form of the verb. It is inappropriate here because the sentence needs a past tense verb to indicate that the action has already been completed.
